Hi Samira — great questions. A few notes so we have a clear action plan: 

- Audit logs: Redwood retains request and audit logs for 90 days in hosted by default; we can provide SOC 2 evidence (report + control descriptions) as part of standard onboarding. If HorizonFin needs longer retention, that becomes part of Dedicated/Contracting exceptions.
- Data retention/deletion: Standard hosted language allows deletion within a 30-day window after termination for customer content; we can offer an addendum for extended deletion windows if required. I'll flag the specific clause numbers when we produce the MSA redline.

Next steps (internal owners):
- Kimberly: compile SOC 2 evidence bundle and data deletion language snippets (ETA: 2 business days).
- Laura: collect billing/contact exhibit template and prepare an exhibit draft (ETA: 48 hours).
- Avery: produce initial MSA redline focusing on commercial flags + residency carveouts (ETA: 3 business days).

Samira — would you like us to send the redline as track changes in Word or as a marked PDF? We can do either; Word makes legal redline consumption easier for many procurement teams.

Thanks — looping legal as needed after the initial redline.

-Kim
